onboarding.welcome.title: Your band, your data
onboarding.welcome.subtitle: Readiness, sleep and load from your WHOOP 5.0 / MG band. Everything stays on this phone.
onboarding.welcome.demo: Skip and use the demo band
onboarding.profile.title: What should we call you?
onboarding.profile.subtitle: Only used to greet you in the app. You can leave it empty.
onboarding.profile.accountNotBuilt: An optional account for backup and sync is not built yet. For now everything stays on this phone.
onboarding.profile.promiseLocal: Your data is stored on this phone only.
onboarding.profile.promiseExport: You can export everything at any time.
onboarding.body.title: About your body
onboarding.body.subtitle: Used to personalise heart rate zones and load. All fields are optional.
onboarding.body.sexNote: Optional. It is not used to compute any score today.
onboarding.body.invalid: Check your input: height 80 to 250 cm, weight 25 to 300 kg, birth year between 1900 and this year, maximum heart rate 120 to 230.
onboarding.goals.title: What matters most?
onboarding.goals.subtitle: Pick as many as you like. This only decides what we highlight.
onboarding.goals.controlBody: You can change your goals and the layout of your home screen at any time.
onboarding.permissions.title: Permissions
onboarding.permissions.subtitle: OpenHoop asks your phone only for what it needs, when it needs it.
onboarding.permissions.bluetoothBody: Required to find and talk to your band. Your phone asks for it when you search for a band.
onboarding.permissions.notificationsBody: A morning digest and a warning when a sync fails. Your phone asks for permission only when you turn this on.
onboarding.permissions.locationBody: Would be needed for route recording during activities. Not used today.
onboarding.official.title: Before you pair
onboarding.official.subtitle: A band can talk to one app at a time.
onboarding.official.onlyBody: If the band is paired with another phone or app, forget it in that phone's Bluetooth settings first.
onboarding.official.switchBody: You can pair the band with the official app again at any time. Unpair it from OpenHoop first, then pair it there.
onboarding.official.firmwareBody: OpenHoop never updates or changes the band's firmware. Updates are made by the official app.
onboarding.pair.title: Find your band
onboarding.pair.subtitle: Charge the band, keep it next to your phone and turn Bluetooth on.
onboarding.connected.title: Band paired
onboarding.connected.subtitle: This is what OpenHoop read from your band.
onboarding.connected.readOnly: OpenHoop only reads from the band. It never writes settings or erases anything.
onboarding.setup.title: Setting things up
onboarding.setup.subtitle: Fetching the history stored on your band. This can take a few minutes.
onboarding.setup.noFirmware: Nothing is changed on the band.
onboarding.wear.title: How to wear it
onboarding.wear.subtitle: A snug fit gives the cleanest readings, day and night.
onboarding.wear.wristBody: A finger width above the wrist bone.
onboarding.wear.garmentBody: With a compatible sleeve or band.
onboarding.wear.tip2: Keep the sensor clean and dry.
onboarding.wear.tip3: Wear it during sleep for the best results.
onboarding.calibration.title: Learning your normal: {count} nights
onboarding.calibration.subtitle: Scores need a few nights of sleep to compare against your own baseline. Until then they are an indication.
onboarding.calibration.night1: First readings arrive. Scores are shown as an indication.
onboarding.calibration.night3: A first normal range for HRV and resting heart rate takes shape.
onboarding.calibration.night4: Ranges and readiness are based on your own baseline.
more.accuracyBody: What we know about each value
device.title: Device settings
device.configBody: What OpenHoop knows about the band
device.actionsNotBuilt: Test haptics, find band, heart rate broadcast and high-rate motion need band write access, which is not built yet.
device.firmwareBody: Firmware updates can change the data format. OpenHoop never updates firmware.
device.flags.title: Feature flags
device.flags.body: OpenHoop does not read the band's feature flags yet, so there is no comparison with the official profile to show.
device.flags.levelD: Level D: raw configuration as read from the band, nothing interpreted.
device.pack.title: Battery pack
device.pack.body: A wireless battery pack has its own Bluetooth service that OpenHoop does not read yet. Its charge and cycles are not shown, and nothing is estimated.
device.safety.title: Safety lock
device.safety.heading: Irreversible band actions
device.safety.body: Wiping, restarting or unpairing a band cannot be undone. Each of these needs a typed confirmation.
device.safety.howBody: You type the confirmation word before the button turns on. This version of OpenHoop contains no code that sends such a command, so confirming does nothing.
appSettings.title: App settings
appSettings.themeBody: Light and dark follow your phone's setting.
appSettings.syncProblemsBody: When a sync fails, or the band has not synced for {days} days
appSettings.homeLayoutBody: Customise or restore the previous layout
appSettings.integrations.healthConnectBo: Would write heart rate, steps, sleep and SpO2
appSettings.integrations.scaleBody: Would read weight via Health Connect
appSettings.provider.title: Connect a provider
appSettings.provider.partnerBody: They rely on servers or people. Plug one in later, or skip them.
appSettings.provider.consent: A provider would only see what you approve, per data type, and you could revoke it at any time.
privacy.title: Data and privacy
privacy.promiseLocal: Your readings and scores live on this phone.
privacy.promiseEncrypted: The database is encrypted on this phone.
privacy.promiseNoNetwork: OpenHoop sends no data over the network.
privacy.importExportBody: Back up your data or bring a file in
privacy.deleteBody: There is no in-app wipe yet. Uninstalling the app removes the database. Moving the "worn since" date later deletes readings before it.
privacy.import.title: Import
privacy.import.useBody: Comparing past scores night by night, and keeping history from before OpenHoop clearly labelled and separate from ours.
privacy.import.localBody: A file would be read locally. Nothing is uploaded.
dev.title: Developer mode
dev.introBody: Nothing here changes your data or the band.
dev.selftestBody: Encryption and pipeline checks on this device
dev.statesBody: Examples of every empty and error state
dev.noPacketLog: A live packet log is not available yet.
aboutx.accuracyLink: Read how the levels are assigned
aboutx.support.freeBody: Every feature is free and there are no paywalls. The best way to help is to report problems and contribute code.
aboutx.accuracy.title: Accuracy report
aboutx.accuracy.heading: Not measured yet
aboutx.accuracy.body: OpenHoop has not compared its values with a reference yet, so there are no accuracy numbers here. Each value shows how it is produced instead.
aboutx.accuracy.importBody: Would let us compare night by night
community.teamsBody: OpenHoop is local-first, so there are no teams by default. Sharing is planned as opt-in.
community.selfHostBody: Plug-in, you choose what is shared
community.ownBody: A teams plug-in would only see the scores you pick, per team.
states.notConnected.title: Band not connected
states.notConnected.body: Bring it close and make sure Bluetooth is on.
states.syncing.title: Syncing with the band
states.syncing.body: You can keep using the app.
states.lowBattery.title: Low band battery
states.charging.title: Charging
states.charging.body: The band is charging. Tracking pauses while it is off your wrist.
states.calibrating.title: Calibrating: {count} nights left
states.calibrating.body: Scores appear once we know your normal.
states.noData.title: No data for this day
states.noData.body: The band was not worn. Nothing to show, and no guesses.
states.needsMg.title: Needs MG hardware
states.needsMg.body: ECG and blood pressure research need a WHOOP MG band.
states.offline.title: Offline
states.offline.body: Nothing needs the internet. Your data is safe on this phone.
states.dataAtRisk.title: Data at risk
states.dataAtRisk.body: No sync for {days} days. The band overwrites its history after about 20 days.
states.firstDay.title: First day
states.firstDay.body: Wear your band tonight. Your first scores arrive tomorrow morning.
states.gallery.title: System states
states.gallery.intro: Developer mode: examples of the states the app shows when there is nothing to show. The numbers are placeholders.
onboarding.permissions.notificationsBloc: Notifications are blocked for OpenHoop in your phone settings.
appSettings.notificationsAllowBody: Your phone asks for permission when you turn this on.
appSettings.notificationsBlocked: Notifications are blocked for OpenHoop in your phone settings. Allow them there first.
appSettings.quietInvalid: Not a valid time. Use HH:MM.
appSettings.notificationsLocal: Notifications are scheduled on this phone only. There is no server and no push service. The digest arrives at 07:00, or when your quiet hours end.
